name: agentarmy-schema-migrator
description: Init-container function-tier image. Runs to completion before backend-core (or any other migration-consuming spoke) starts. Applies idempotent schema migrations against Postgres (DBOS system DB + app DB) and ArcadeDB (graph schema). Pairs with ARC-ADR-023's 'init container' composition pattern. Scaffolded as part of the contract-backlog PR; real implementation lands in the schema-migration-engineer agent's first work cycle.

shims.note: PLANNED — alembic for Postgres + DBOS migrations; HTTP-based DDL execution for ArcadeDB (its REST API takes SQL strings). dryrun mode emits the migration plan without applying.

baked.purpose: PLANNED — alembic revision tree shared across spokes that point at the same Postgres instance.
PLANNED — versioned ArcadeDB schema DDLs (CREATE TYPE, INDEX, etc.) with idempotency guards.
PLANNED — connect-wait → apply → record version → exit 0; or fail fast and exit nonzero so depends_on holds.
PLANNED — applies twice in a row; second run must be a no-op (idempotency).

doctor.description: PLANNED — run migrate twice → second run is a no-op; force a bad revision → exits nonzero so compose depends_on holds.

deploy.notes: Deployed as a Container Apps Job (run-to-completion) before the depending spoke. Locally composed via `depends_on.condition: service_completed_successfully` against the application-tier container.

contract.note: No external HTTP contract — this is an init container. The 'contract' is the migration-versioning convention (alembic linear history; ArcadeDB versioned by stored procedure that records applied revisions in a meta table).
